libs.note: BH-3433 (contract slice BH-3442). A review BLOCK whose only open finding is a human step is held on the issue instead of rebuilt. bin/lib/needs-human.sh is the interface over bin/lib/needs-human/{classify,trip,release}.sh, all live. The hold is on by default. Kill switch: lane_switch needs-human-hold-off (the file flags/needs-human-hold-off), read by bin/needs-human-hold.sh and bin/lib/needs-human/trip.sh, stops every hold the review stage, the resolver and the tripwire would place.

knobs.note: How many review BLOCKs with the same needs-human fingerprint on one issue trip the hold. Settings key lib.needs-human.needs_human_trip_count. Read by nh_trip_note in bin/lib/needs-human/trip.sh (BH-3445).
